papers.title: Microstructural characteristic and mechanical property of Ti6Al4V alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Shanghai Engineering Research Center of 3D Printing Materials, Handan Road 99, Shanghai 200437, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Beibei He
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Shanghai Engineering Research Center of 3D Printing Materials, Handan Road 99, Shanghai 200437, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Wenheng Wu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Shanghai Research Institute of Materials, Handan Road 99, Shanghai 200437, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备Ti6Al4V的显微组织和力学性能，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备Ti6Al4V的显微组织和力学性能关系
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备样品，进行显微组织观察和力学测试
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数对微观组织和力学性能的影响

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the relationship between microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti6Al4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM and characterized for microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: The influence of process parameters on microstructure and mechanical properties was revealed.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing validated the property findings.

papers.title: Evidence-Based Thresholds for the Volume and Length of Stay Relationship in Total Hip Arthroplasty: Outcomes and Economies of Scale
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Cleveland Clinic, Cleveland, OH

corresponding_authors.name: Prem N. Ramkumar
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Cleveland Clinic, Cleveland, OH

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术的住院时长与手术量的关系，未涉及任何生物力学或有限元建模内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study with no biomechanical modeling, no implant stress analysis, no micromotion or FEA, and does not address the user's direction of hip implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨全髋关节置换术手术量与住院时长的关系
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析大量病例数据，建立阈值模型
summary_zh.result: 发现手术量超过特定阈值后住院时长显著减少
summary_zh.validation: 基于真实患者数据的统计学验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the relationship between hospital volume and length of stay in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of large-scale patient data to establish evidence-based volume thresholds.
summary_en.result: Higher surgical volume beyond a threshold is associated with reduced length of stay.
summary_en.validation: Statistical validation using real-world clinical data.

papers.title: Comparison of Postoperative Complications Following Metal-on-Metal Total Hip Arthroplasty With Other Hip Bearings in Medicare Population
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Duke University Medical Center, Durham, North Carolina

corresponding_authors.name: Lindsay T. Kleeman
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Duke University Medical Center, Durham, North Carolina

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床流行病学研究，未涉及任何生物力学建模、应力分析或微动分析，与用户研究方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomechanical modeling, FEA, stress/strain analysis, micromotion quantification, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较金属对金属髋关节置换术与其他轴承在Medicare人群中的并发症风险。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析Medicare数据库，比较不同轴承类型的术后并发症发生率。
summary_zh.result: 金属对金属轴承与较高的并发症风险相关，尤其是假体周围骨折和脱位。
summary_zh.validation: 基于大样本Medicare数据库的回顾性研究。

summary_en.motivation: To compare postoperative complication rates of metal-on-metal total hip arthroplasty versus other bearing surfaces in a Medicare population.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of Medicare claims data comparing complication incidences across bearing types.
summary_en.result: Metal-on-metal bearings were associated with higher risks of specific complications, including periprosthetic fracture and dislocation.
summary_en.validation: Validation through a large-scale retrospective database analysis with propensity score matching.
